title: 1998 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup final
displaytitle: 1998 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup final

titles.display: 1998 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup final

extract: The 1998 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup final was a football match that took place on 13 May 1998 at Råsunda Stadium in Stockholm, Sweden to determine the winner of the 1997–98 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup. It was contested by Chelsea of England and VfB Stuttgart of Germany and was the 38th final of what was Europe's second largest football competition at the time.
